|strategy=By [mailto:jralrea@ilstu.edu Joe Alread]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/maincourse.html</ref>

The magic bullet for [[Frozen Assets]] is nice, but how about the second use as well? Rebels and Aliens mix and match all the time in a Light deck (look at [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] and [[Chewbacca]]! ), thus by playing this recyclable five destiny card to have a good chance of reducing attrition against you in a battle to zero sounds pretty good to me! And if [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] shows up, you have even a better chance of avoiding battle damage in that battle!
